description: Verify that the build log contains no lines matching the regex 'error' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log contains no lines matching the regex 'fatal' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log contains a line matching the regex 'Build succeeded' or 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' (case-insensitive).
Verify that the build log does not contain any lines starting with 'ERROR:' or 'FATAL:'.
